response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or IDE internals — core requirements for this role. Their work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only minimal, outdated Java exposure (e.g., robotic arms at Altom), and no evidence of enterprise framework or build tool integration in IDEs.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source tooling and developer education
Extensive experience with CI/CD, testing, and dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No recent or substantial Java/Kotlin production experience
Zero evidence of work on IDEs, language servers, or JVM tooling
Enterprise frameworks (Spring, Hibernate) and build tools (Maven/Gradle) unmentioned
